name: Sonoff TRVZB
notes: Firmware 1.3.0 or newer: valve_opening_degree and valve_closing_degree need 1.1.4, temperature_accuracy 1.3.0.
Set temperature_sensor_select to remote_temperature to use the external temperature.
Switch off smart_temperature_control: it disables manual valve positions.
temperature_accuracy -0.2: the thermostat heats with the planned opening as soon as the room is 0.2 K below the setpoint (factory -1 K).
closing_steps 0: the valve lost its calibration (e.g. after a firmware update) and stays in the mounting position, fully open; a short press on the button recalibrates.
